title: Ops Orchestra: runbook curator + PD/Slack adaptor with trace-linked snapshots
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build an orchestration component ("Ops Orchestra") that synthesizes traces, metrics, and recent logs to: 1) score incoming incidents for likely root causes; 2) auto-curate a prioritized runbook with concrete remediation steps and example curl/kubectl commands; 3) attach a compact trace-linked snapshot to PagerDuty and Slack alerts; and 4) auto-generate a draft postmortem with timeline and affected routes when incidents are acknowledged. Focus is integration with PD/Slack hooks and the Console’s incident UI. Non-goals: full autonomous remediation in this scope, long-term ML model training for scoring (we'll use heuristics + lightweight learned signals).
acceptance_criteria: PD integration: PagerDuty incidents created by our alert pipeline include a 'trace_snapshot_url' and top-3 suspected root causes in the PD payload (JSON field 'context.ops_orchestra').
Slack alerts: Slack channel messages include action buttons (Acknowledge / View Runbook / Create Postmortem) and a compact attachment with trace thumbnail and 3-line timeline.
Runbook curation: For >= 80% of triggered playbooks in staging, Ops Orchestra suggests at least 2 viable remediation steps with example commands and relevant dashboards links.
Draft postmortem: When incident is resolved, a draft postmortem is created in the configured Confluence/Drive template with a prefilled timeline, affected routes, and suggested follow-ups.
Observability UI: Console shows Ops Orchestra score, suspect spans, and link to the generated runbook in the incident sidebar.
Tests: end-to-end test that simulates a latency spike creates PD+Slack artifacts with trace snapshot and runbook link (automated in CI).
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff meeting with PM and SREs. Decided to reuse the existing trace summarizer service and extend its schema for 'snapshot hints'. Action: design doc assigned.

2026-03-03: Prototype: extracted top-5 hot spans from a sampled latency event and rendered a compact snapshot — proof-of-concept screenshot uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/ops-orchestra-poc-snapshot
2026-03-04: Design doc published: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Ops+Orchestra+Design (includes message schemas, PD/Slack payload examples, and Console wireframes).

2026-03-06: Decided on PD payload field name 'context.ops_orchestra' to avoid collision with existing tooling. Noted PD rate limits and decided to attach only a short URL to the full snapshot. Filed ENG-210999 as umbrella for engineering work.
2026-03-07: Implemented PD hook adaptor library (internal npm package). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4982 — includes unit tests for serialization and fallback logic.

2026-03-08: Slack manifest updated to add action buttons. UX review feedback: make 'View Runbook' open in Console incident pane rather than external link. Updated Console route PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1229.
2026-03-09: Integration test created to replay a recorded incident trace and assert PD payload contents; running on staging pipeline. Link to CI run: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/ops-orchestra/312.

2026-03-11: Cross-team review with Security. Decided to encrypt snapshot URLs with short-lived signed tokens (KMS integration required). Security review required flag set. Created KMS ticket: SECU-77.

2026-03-12: First end-to-end run in staging succeeded: PD incident contained 'trace_snapshot_url' and Slack message rendered action buttons. Collected feedback from oncall: shorten timeline, include top-2 correlated metrics. Updating runbook curation heuristics.
risks: PD/Slack rate limits: attaching snapshots increases payloads; mitigated by short URLs and rate-guarding in adaptor.
Sensitive data exposure: traces may include PII — decided to run a redaction pass and require signed short-lived URLs. Security review and KMS integration pending.
False positives in heuristic scoring could bloat runbook suggestions — keep heuristics conservative and provide manual edit in Console.
Operational cost: snapshot generation and storage could increase S3 and compute; we'll implement TTL and dedupe snapshots by trace fingerprint.
testing_plan: Unit tests for PD/Slack adaptor serialization and fallback behaviors.
Integration replay test that injects a recorded trace into staging alert pipeline and asserts PD/Slack payloads.
Manual SRE runbook validation session where oncall engineers rate curated runbook usefulness (target >= 4/5).
Load test to ensure snapshot generation scales with expected alert burst rates.
